name: Marvo LT front derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 154 g reference for the 2x9 band-mounted front derailleur, with the documented 34.9 mm clamp. Smaller mounting diameters use optional reducers; no weight is transferred to a direct-mount variant.
